blocks.text: Today, Atlantic Records announces Nobody Wants This Season 3: (Soundtrack from the Netflix Series), the official musical companion to season three of Netflix’s hit romantic comedy series, and unveils its star-studded tracklist. Set for release on October 23, the 16-track compilation brings together an all-star lineup of global hitmakers and breakthrough talent, featuring all-new, previously unreleased recordings featured specifically in the show. Watch the official tracklist reveal video HERE and pre-order/pre-save the upcoming album HERE. Nobody Wants This Season 3 premieres globally on Netflix on October 22.
